title: shipped a redesign
summary: we now have a proper palette system, new scene backgrounds, and updated colors across the board. turns out having an actual color system is easier than guessing hex codes every time

highlights.title: Fresh coat of pixels
highlights.text: The [main website](https://hello.pollinations.ai) has a new look. We replaced the old theming engine with a cohesive color palette and dynamic retro pixel art backgrounds. Much cozier.
